name: Dinkey Lakes Loop
notes: Classic Sierra National Forest lake-basin loop. The current Recreation.gov export supplies quota-entry/corridor points, not individual named tent pads; use the Dinkey Lakes Wilderness map to select actual campsites and comply with dispersed-camping setbacks.

name: Ansel Adams Wilderness: Mono Pass / Lake Basin Traverse
notes: Representative Ansel Adams Wilderness one-way corridor. Permit records are entry quotas and do not identify every legal backcountry campsite; route length depends on the selected lake basin and pass.

name: Kaiser Wilderness Lakes Loop
notes: Kaiser Wilderness loop built from the permit corridors available in this app. These are quota-entry points rather than designated campsites; verify the Forest Service wilderness map and current fire restrictions.
